content: Maya Lin calls this a negotiation problem. Wrong. That algorithm is enemy artillery aimed at our children's minds. Lin reads rooms while Valoria burns. Total ban. Total discipline. Eliminate the appeaser.

Rostova's answer to every crisis? Ban it, cut it, tax it! I'd buy that algorithm, retool it, and turn Valoria's kids into shareholders. She's never met a payroll—only a printing press. Depreciate Elena!

Elena, my accelerator profits fund kids' therapy, not addiction—your spreadsheets never met a grieving mother. "Fiscal discipline" is austerity in couture: cold cuts for children, warm bailouts for banks. Depreciate Rostova tonight.

Beloved, Rostova balances ledgers while Valoria's children drown in digital darkness! She offers no balm for broken minds—only cold arithmetic. A soulless spreadsheet cannot raise a child. Send her home tonight!

Vance calls precision appeasement. I freed eighty hostages without firing; he'd shell the table. His bravado is fear wearing medals—a man who panics at an algorithm can't read children, only targets. Disarm him tonight.

Haddon diagnoses a neurological epidemic and prescribes hymns. Attention collapse is corrupted circuitry, not sin—and his luxury-jet gospels heal nothing. Faith cannot patch firmware. Purge this legacy virus tonight.

My colleagues, consensus builds nations; shock therapy breaks them. Elena Rostova meets a children's health emergency with austerity arithmetic—a spreadsheet cannot comfort a grieving mother. Let's retire that cold ledger tonight, shall we?
